Test provider routing by sending requests to OpenAI and Anthropic

```swift title="Swift"
import Foundation
import LiterLlm

let _req = try LiterLlm.chatCompletionRequestFromJson("{\"max_tokens\":5,\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Say hi.\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"openai/gpt-4o-mini\"}")
guard let _apiKey = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["OPENAI_API_KEY"] else { fatalError("OPENAI_API_KEY must be set") }
let _client = try createClient(apiKey: _apiKey, baseUrl: nil)
let result = try await _client.chat(_req)
debugPrint(result.choices())
```
